_doc: Sheet compounds and typos -> the words the stores write, read by catalog_match.sheet_names BEFORE identity parsing (size, variants, product-type words) and the query plan. Never applied to the sku_key: identity.make_sku_key keeps the raw sheet name and the size parsed from it, so editing this file never orphans an approval, a rejection or a queued row. Keys are matched like data/abbreviations.json keys (catalog_match.abbreviations.rewrite): whole words on normalised tokens, longest key first, never inside another word or abbreviation; the words take the case style of the sheet text. An entry with a 'context' (a token set of variants_lexicon.json 'contexts') applies only when the name, Arabic name, category or class words hold a token of it. Each entry has a one-line 'why' naming the live row it comes from. Be conservative: list only a spelling that has no other reading in a grocery name; a size or a brand is never 'corrected' here (brand spellings belong in the Brands Mapping sheet, shorthand in abbreviations.json).
